description: Use this when the user asks what behind-the-meter gas power costs in a US data-center market: Henry Hub spot, regional basis differential, and the delivered industrial + electric gas tariff ($/MMBtu), each with its own source label. Pass market=<slug> (e.g. "northern-virginia", "dallas", "phoenix"). AZ, GA, FL), never a substitute price; if the backend switch is ever turned off again, `gas_to_grid_status` carries that reason. ★ DO NOT COMPARE a $/MWh published before 2026-09-27 with one published now — each surface then picked the price its own way, up to 5.5x apart. Do not derive a $/MWh yourself from the $/MMBtu layers for a withheld state without saying that you did. Every caller gets the EIA state survey prices (public domain): delivered_industrial_usd_mmbtu, delivered_electric_usd_mmbtu and the burner_tip price with its monthly min/max; figure_labels gives each figure's source, basis, period and as_of. The regional hub price and basis, gas_price_used_usd_mmbtu and the $/MWh table come with a full-access key, and figure_labels.henry_hub_spot_usd_mmbtu.served_to says who gets the Henry Hub spot. Do NOT use for the electricity grid fuel mix (use get_grid_data). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

heat_rate_btu_per_kwh.description: Optional custom generator heat rate in Btu/kWh for the gas-to-grid $/MWh scenario, e.g. 6800 (avg CCGT)

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank
